label: Rakuten Advertising
terms_note: API tokens are generated per account in the developer portal (access-token guide present, terms not read).

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (advertiser reporting APIs on a portal that was unreadable this pass) Confidence: **low**.

reason: Docs now readable but publisher-only. On 2026-09-25 headless Chromium rendered https://developers.rakutenadvertising.com/documentation/en-US/affiliate_apis (OAS3 'Affiliate APIs' on https://api.linksynergy.com: Advanced Reports (payment history), Advertiser Search, Coupon, Events transactions, Link Locator, Product Search, Deep Link, Advertisers, Postback, Offers, Partnerships, Commissioning Lists, Conversion Journey API for Publisher) and the token guide https://developers.rakutenadvertising.com/guides/access_tokens. These are publisher-side affiliate APIs; none lists an advertiser's accounts, programmes/campaigns, spend reports, budgets or status, so no ads verb maps.
